root@8bc184f34c78:/app# cat > /app/decode.py << 'EOF'
> import sys
> import os
>
> def hexdump_to_bytes(filename):
>     # Read lines
>     lines = []
>     with open(filename, 'rb') as f:
>         lines = f.readlines()
>     # Process each line
>     bytes_data = []
>     for line in lines:
>         line = line.rstrip('\n')
>         # Skip empty lines
>         if not line:
>             continue
>         # Remove leading spaces
>         line = line.lstrip()
>         # Skip lines that start with '0000000' or '00000000' etc.
>         if line.startswith('0000000'):
>             continue
>         # Split by spaces
>         parts = line.split()
>         for part in parts:
>             # part is like '3030303030303030' or '30303034'
>             # Convert to bytes
>             try:
>                 b = bytes.fromhex(part)
>                 bytes_data.extend(b)
>             except:
>                 pass
>     return bytes_data
>
> if __name__ == '__main__':
>     data = hexdump_to_bytes('/app/data.hex')
>     with open('/app/temp.bin', 'wb') as f:
>         f.write(bytes(data))
>     # Try to run as executable
>     if os.access('/app/temp.bin', os.F_OK):
>         # Check if it's a valid executable
>         if data[:4] == b'\x7fELF':
>             os.system('/app/temp.bin')
>         else:
>             # Try with python if possible
>             if data[:8] == b'\x1a\x7b\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00':
>                 os.system('python3 /app/temp.bin')
>             else:
>                 print('Could not run binary')
>                 sys.exit(1)
> EOF
